source.from: the streamGenerateContent request Gemini CLI sends through @google/genai with GEMINI_API_KEY set: a model's method on generativelanguage.googleapis.com with the turn in contents; written from the Gemini API reference, with one user turn

expect.why: Gemini CLI runs as node.exe, which names no app, so the request is named by its host, generativelanguage.googleapis.com, which is the Google AI API's (app:google_ai_api)
